study_boundary: Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) limits as the city denominator: approximately 650 sq km across 6 zones, 30 circles, and 150 wards, spanning Hyderabad and parts of Medchal-Malkajgiri, Ranga Reddy, and Sangareddy districts. Evidence for Hyderabad District alone, the wider Hyderabad Metropolitan Region, areas up to the Outer Ring Road, or individual adjoining districts must retain its true denominator and be labelled as district or wider-frame context rather than citywide GHMC coverage.

include_domains: aquifer geometry, disposition, boundaries, thickness, weathered zones, fractured zones, and productive depths
groundwater levels, monitoring wells, seasonal and long-term trends
groundwater resource assessment, recharge, extraction, stress, and status
groundwater quality, sampling locations, parameters, exceedances, and trends
exploratory wells, piezometers, pumping tests, geophysics, and borehole logs that directly characterize aquifers or groundwater
supporting_evidence: geology, granitic lithology, structure, lineaments, soils, lakes, drainage, or land use only when directly required to interpret aquifer geometry, recharge, groundwater flow, quality, or well depths
exclude_domains: general geology or lineament mapping without a direct aquifer or groundwater role
standalone soil, lake, or drainage mapping without recharge, groundwater-quality, or aquifer relevance
seismic hazard, deformation, and microzonation without a direct groundwater relationship
metro, utility, tunnel, foundation, and infrastructure studies without groundwater observations or aquifer evidence

evidence_gaps: GHMC-scale hard-rock aquifer geometry, weathered-zone thickness, fractures, and productive well depths
recent located groundwater-level observations and seasonal or long-term trends
current groundwater resource status, recharge, extraction stress, and over-exploited assessment units
recent located groundwater-quality observations and exceedances
aquifer-characterization wells, yields, pumping tests, and geophysical or borehole evidence
target_capabilities: aquifer depth, weathered-zone, and fracture map
groundwater status, recharge, and extraction map

source_policy.older_dynamic_evidence: exclude from acquisition and selection; record only as an unresolved or historical lead
source_policy.older_stable_evidence: exclude from acquisition and selection; record only as an unresolved lead and search for an in-window successor

preferred_publishers: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board
